items.title: Steve "Ted" Brown Interview, 1958-04-22
items.q: McKinney's Cotton Pickers? Well, they originated in Detroit. Uh, they were organized and promoted principally by George Horvath, who's dead now.

ctx.x: What about McKinney's? That's another band.

McKinney's Cotton Pickers? Well, they originated in Detroit. Uh, they were organized and promoted principally by George Horvath, who's dead now. And, uh, he's, uh, Charlie Horvath, I mean. Charlie Horvath. He was a promoter for the Goldcat Enterprises, as they call them. Goldcat never did promote anything. He could sell. He was a good salesman. He could go there and sell. But, uh, promoting anything, Charlie Horvath was the one, the real promoter. And he'd, uh, he promoted the Cotton Pickers. After the Victor…
You got the, uh, box there you want to put the machine up so you can hear some of them?
